title: Demystifying the data center
summary: Digital Realty, with Casne Engineering, built a hosted PI and templated AF model for PUE, capacity planning and customer usage across its colocation sites.
challenge: Weekly manual data pulls, Excel tracking and landlord-owned sites that limit data visibility.
solution: A templated AF model "to enforce tag consistency", covering the power chain from utility feed to customer circuits.

outcomes.text: "Time savings of over 50% in viewing reports"
outcomes.reportedBy: The company (Gupana, Lake) in an OSIsoft UC 2017 presentation

title: SCADA replacement with the PI System
summary: Equinix and DST Controls replaced legacy SCADA with PI in 6 weeks at a 54,488 sq ft site, converting 15,000 tags and 115 screens and connecting 108 controllers.
challenge: Unsupported SCADA, weak capacity planning and poor outage notification.
solution: PI with a capacity view, automated monthly energy summaries and about 2,000 reorganised alarms and notifications.

outcomes.reportedBy: Equinix and DST Controls in an OSIsoft UC 2011 presentation

outcomes.text: Servers cut from 2 SCADA servers to 1 PI server
outcomes.reportedBy: Equinix and DST Controls in an OSIsoft UC 2011 presentation

title: eBay enhances data center visibility and forecasting at scale
summary: eBay consolidated its PI Servers, rebuilt its asset framework "from the ground up" and collects 3 million data points in PI, with Clarity DCIM dashboards on top.
challenge: There was no holistic real-time view, and teams relied on spreadsheets.
solution: A cockpit view of power allocation, busway loading, rack power demand and cooling.

outcomes.text: "Faster, data-driven decisions on million-dollar infrastructure investments" (qualitative)

title: Gaining real-time control of data center operations
summary: PayPal separated about 20 years of shared data from eBay's PI System, built its own PI System, and now generates ServiceNow tickets from PI alerts across 33 data centres.
challenge: PayPal had to "untangle 20 years' worth of data" from a shared system.
solution: Its own PI System, with millions of tags plus AF and notification data migrated, and alerts that create ServiceNow tickets.

outcomes.text: Executive reporting "in seconds instead of weeks"

verifyNote: The page is inconsistent: the outcome says "in seconds instead of weeks", while a quote elsewhere says "instead of 40 days later".

title: Making data center billing more flexible and transparent
summary: Aligned Energy models asset relationships in AF and builds billing "charge points" for each customer, at busway level for shared PDUs and at PDU-output level for dedicated PDUs.
challenge: Client load demands vary, and customers want billing transparency.
solution: An AF model of asset relationships with customer portals; customer access through PI Web API is planned.

outcomes.text: "Customers can monitor their own energy usage and unused capacity"
outcomes.reportedBy: AVEVA (customer success story); also a PI World 2018 talk by Energy Metrics

title: Dell EMC gains real-time visibility and streamlines micro data centers management
summary: Dell EMC's MDCi platform runs PI Server on a Dell IoT gateway in each unstaffed micro modular data centre, using PI Connector for Redfish and a Modbus connector.
challenge: Thousands of remote micro data centres with no staff on site.
solution: PI as a "single pane of glass" across the micro data centres.

outcomes.text: For eBay's hyperscale modules, "Reduced asset configuration time from two weeks to four hours"
